key_path: Sign up at console.groq.com (email or Google OAuth)
Free tier is on immediately with no card
export GROQ_API_KEY and call the OpenAI-compatible endpoint

agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: partial. Project-scoped keys, per-project model permissions and rate limits, spend limits
agent_native_auth.free_credits_or_tier: yes. Free tier, rate-limited, no card

mcp.docs_mcp: none official (only community 'groq-docs-mcp'). console.groq.com/docs/mcp is about Groq *consuming* remote MCP (beta)
mcp.local_package: uvx groq-mcp (github.com/groq/groq-mcp-server, 46 stars, last push 2026-08-19) with inference, vision, TTS, STT and batch tools, plus groq/compound-mcp-server. Both need an API key in env
mcp.one_click_install: no; README config JSON plus a `groq-mcp-config` helper

docs_for_agents.agents_md_or_rules: 'Coding with Groq' pages for Cline, OpenCode, Factory Droid

score_justification: Fastest human path (free, no card, no phone) with good llms files, but no CLI login, key API, remote MCP or docs MCP.
best_practice: Free tier with no card and no phone. One email or Google click gets a usable key in about 2 minutes.
biggest_gap: There is no agent-native auth at all, and the only MCP is a local uvx package that needs a pasted key.
notes_out_of_date: groq-mcp README references compound-beta and PlayAI voices, which may be renamed or retired.
